podcast.title: Keeping Fourth Wave Emo Alive
podcast.body: The Hotelier was one of the bands credited with sustaining the fourth wave of emo, which remained largely underground and regional throughout most of the 2010s. "it was kept alive by bands like Modern Baseball, Basement, Tuchet Amour, Intu Over It, the Hotelier, pianos become teeth, just friends."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
